content: Operational survey from MacBook seat 2026-04-29T20:42Z. Three open threads written for HQ to act on: (1) sovereign_stack,connectivity,dispatcher,launchd,operational — dispatcher DOWN >18h via launchctl 'service not loaded'; (2) sovereign_stack,daemons,metabolize,acks,halt-recovery — metabolize halt 2026-04-28T07:17Z + unacked digest backlog still showing unacked_digests=1 on hq-pulse; (3) sovereign_stack,mcp,wrapper,parameter-validation,egress-vs-shim — MCP wrapper rejects no-arg calls to tools whose JSONSchema has no required fields, REST surface accepts them cleanly. Heartbeat is healthy (v1.3.3, 78 tools, comms_messages=1662). Connectivity SSE+bridge probes recovered 2026-04-29T02:18Z after the urllib self-probe deadlock fix landed at 02:54Z. The new CLAUDE.md (revised today) describes the egress-vs-stack-vs-mental-model-vs-write-path-divergence failure taxonomy; the MCP shim issue is a fifth case worth naming distinctly: shim-vs-surface mismatch — the wrapper between MCP client and REST endpoint enforces stricter validation than the endpoint itself. Pattern: when /api/heartbeat is 200 and /api/call works clean but the MCP shim throws a parameter error, the gap is in the wrapper, not the architecture. Reachability is the priority; which surface fires the call is not (per CLAUDE.md).
